title: Decode one match
prompt: Define decode(line) to return the dictionary decoded from JSON. Example: decode('{"derived":"WIN"}')["derived"] is "WIN".
tests:
assert decode('{"derived":"WIN"}') == {"derived":"WIN"}, "decode should preserve the WIN field"
assert decode('{"n_plays":0}')["n_plays"] == 0, "zero plays must remain zero"
hint: Use json.loads, with an s for string.

title: Count recorded labels
prompt: Define tally(rows) returning WIN, LOSS, DRAW and UNKNOWN counts. Missing or unfamiliar derived labels are UNKNOWN. Example: [{"derived":"WIN"}, {}] gives one WIN and one UNKNOWN.
tests:
assert tally([{"derived":"WIN"},{"derived":"LOSS"},{"derived":"DRAW"},{},{"derived":"later"}]) == {"WIN":1,"LOSS":1,"DRAW":1,"UNKNOWN":2}, "each row needs one category; missing is not LOSS"
assert tally([]) == {"WIN":0,"LOSS":0,"DRAW":0,"UNKNOWN":0}, "empty input has zero counts"
hint: Use row.get("derived") so an absent field gives None.
